resources.name: RouteViews
quotes: To obtain a complete list of prefixes announced in the global routing system, we use routing table (RIB) dumps from a large Route Views collector (route-views4).
Here, we rely on daily snapshots from Route Views [1] and remove any /24 subnet that is not inside an announced prefix as seen by Route Views.
references: [1] 2023. Routeviews Project – University of Oregon. http://www.routeviews.org/.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors use Route Views RIB dumps to obtain a complete list of prefixes announced in the global routing system as a starting point for their inferences.

resources.name: Prefix2AS Dataset
quotes: To this end, we use CAIDA’s prefix-to-AS mapping data set (published daily) from April 24, 2023 [9], which is based on Route Views RIB dumps.
references: [9] CAIDA. 2023. Routeviews Prefix to AS mappings Dataset for IPv4 and IPv6 . https://www.caida.org/catalog/datasets/routeviews-prefix2as/.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors use CAIDA's prefix-to-AS mapping dataset to characterize the portion of inferred dark address space belonging to individual Autonomous Systems.

resources.name: M-Lab NDT (Network Diagnostic Tool)
quotes: we use data from three measurement projects that confirms “liveness” of individual IP addresses: M-Lab’s Network Diagnosis Tool (NDT)

resources.name: Censys Universal Internet Dataset
quotes: The Censys Universal Internet [23] data set is generated by scanning the entire IPv4 address space on multiple ports and protocols on a daily basis. We identify roughly 4.8 million active /24 IPv4 prefixes using this data for the week April 24 – April 30, 2023.
references: [23] Zakir Durumeric, David Adrian, Ariana Mirian, Michael Bailey, and J. Alex Halderman. 2015. A Search Engine Backed by Internet-Wide Scanning.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors use the Censys Universal Internet dataset to identify active /24 IPv4 prefixes to validate their results and filter false positives.

resources.name: Internet Address History
